entities.summary:
Onésimo Cepeda Silva 
He is a banker, businessman, investor, and stockbroker. In 1965, together with Carlos Slim Helú, he co-founded Inversora Bursátil Inbursa, S.A. de C.V., and served as its chief executive officer until his retirement; the company later became Grupo Financiero Inbursa in 2000. He was also a Mexican Catholic bishop. He was the first Bishop of Ecatepec, serving from 1999 until his resignation in 2012 was a Mexican Roman Catholic prelate.
